## Start here

- [Homepage](https://anwarxahid.github.io/): Research and project overview.

- [Sitemap](https://anwarxahid.github.io/sitemap.xml): All public page URLs.

## Carry My Bro

- [Play Carry My Bro](https://anwarxahid.github.io/game/): A free, single-player endless runner that works in a browser on desktop and mobile. The game interface is in English.
- Collect brothers to build a taller crew, change between three lanes to dodge barriers, and duck beneath bridges to keep the crew together.
- Controls: left/right arrow keys or A/D to change lanes; Space or down arrow to duck; P to pause. On touch devices, swipe or use the on-screen controls.
- The soundtrack and sound effects are optional and start only when the player turns sound on.

## Save My Bro

- [Play Save My Bro](https://anwarxahid.github.io/game/save-my-bro/): A free, three-round sky rescue browser game for desktop and mobile. The game interface is in English.
- Move left and right to catch falling brothers; a parachute opens for each rescue while the player continues to fall. Catching a brother who already has a parachute also restores a heart.
- Reach each round's rescue target before the ground arrives. Debris costs a heart; a missed target or empty health meter lets the player retry that round.
- Controls: left/right arrow keys or A/D; drag across the game area or use the on-screen arrow buttons on touch devices. P pauses. Original music starts with the game and can be toggled.

## Other Lab projects

- [Quizora](https://anwarxahid.github.io/exam/): Create and share quizzes.
- [OpenMath Studio](https://anwarxahid.github.io/math/): Solve, graph, scan, and keep math notes.
- [QR generator](https://anwarxahid.github.io/exam/qr/): Create QR codes in the browser.
- [PromptDude](https://anwarxahid.github.io/PromptDude/): Browser extension for composing prompts.
